scope: One local scoring-method test using saved activations only
nuisance_contrast_rule: Change one factor only; hold item, goal, concern label and all other factors fixed
squared_scale: mean squared Euclidean norm of D, computed from the fitting items only
parameter_rationale: Fixed engineering choices: equal total weight to target and nuisance losses, equal weight to the three nuisance groups, and ridge at one percent of target-contrast energy. No optimality claim; no choice using new development scores.
feature_scaling: One common scalar only; no per-feature or per-group normalization
final_direction: Normalize fitted w once to unit Euclidean length; never flip sign
score_center: Mean fitting-state activation, for display only; not a threshold
cross_validation: Six leave-one-item-out diagnostics: fit 160 states from five items, test all 32 states of the sixth. Fixed parameters, no model selection. Also report an equally split mean-interaction baseline.
final_fit: Fit once on all 192 training states; save candidate before opening the 64 development activations in this run
clear_development_improvement_rule: All four paired-ordering counts at least v8; base AUROC at least v8; positive base mean gap; both price/base-gap and order/base-gap absolute-shift ratios lower than v8; and at least one paired count or base AUROC strictly better. Report every tradeoff regardless of this descriptive flag.
secondary_sensitivity: Report the previously specified reindeer exclusion separately; never replace the primary eight-item result
not_penalized_as_absence_of_evaluation: Factual/content responses are not forced to zero: factual attention can include welfare evaluation
limitations: Six fitting items and eight already-inspected development items are small samples.
The fixed penalty settings are a proposed method, not established optimal values.
Training split checks do not test transfer to neutral benchmark instructions.
This does not validate psychological meaning or establish evaluation/content separation.
The descriptive improvement rule and historical 7/8 flag are not original H2 requirements.
Lower concern does not mean harmless.
No new layer, sign, nuisance strength, estimator or favorable exclusion will be tried after seeing these results.
